title: Doubao Work Launches 'Workspace': First Batch of 21 Covering Finance, Healthcare, Education, and Other Scenarios

content_html:
On November 16, Doubao launched the "Workspace" feature in Doubao Work, initially covering 21 professional scenarios including finance, healthcare, education, and creative design. This feature provides a dedicated AI space for professional work, preconfigured with the necessary skills and tools so users can start working without choosing from scratch, lowering the barrier to using AI in professional scenarios. The homepage offers 21 workspaces, covering finance and investment research, doctors, teachers, writing, new media creation, data analysis, legal affairs, travel planning, and other areas.

Workspaces are customized by scenario: Finance & Investment Research provides task entries such as announcement interpretation, earnings analysis, market briefings, and company research, and integrates data services such as Wind, Hithink RoyalFlush, and Guotai Haitong; users can call them after connecting and authorizing them in "Plugins"; Creative Design covers skills such as poster design, social media graphics, and brand visuals. After a task is started, a canvas is automatically created, allowing one creative concept to be extended into a series of posters and brand packaging; the Doctor Workspace comes with preconfigured entries such as clinical guideline search, medical literature interpretation, and materials for science communication and patient communication, providing evidence-based references for professional judgment. Official notes state that it is only for medical research assistance and cannot replace a licensed physician's clinical judgment; the Teacher Workspace can generate lesson plans and courseware based on topics and textbooks, turn exercises into interactive experiments with adjustable parameters, and has an official partnership with Xueke.com, allowing users to find teaching resources and similar questions via question images through connectors.

To get started, go to the "Workspace" page, select a direction, and click "Use." When external data services are involved, authorize as prompted. You can also click "Create" in the upper right corner, enter a name, select skill plugins and preferences, and then save and share. Doubao notes that the data in the demo screen should not be cited as actual usage results. Splitting the AI assistant into vertical workspaces with preconfigured skills continues the trend of AI applications moving from general Q&A to industry delivery.
